task_title: AUG-132: spec validate must refuse a corpus whose test citation names a nonexistent path (fix 55a6725, graded at the current merged head)
task_criteria: The shipped AUG-132 fixture is REFUSED by the verb that used to count-only: spec validate on tests/fixtures/xml/invalid/stale-test-obligation exits 2 and stderr names the typed class stale-test-ref, the document stale-test-obligation.xml, the block AUG-VER-STALE-1 and the resolved path tests/does-not-exist.py. FAILIF: rc is 0, or it prints ok, or the class is anything other than stale-test-ref (the pre-fix measurement was "1 document(s), 2 block(s), 1 reference(s) ok" rc 0). PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate tests/fixtures/xml/invalid/stale-test-obligation; echo rc=$?

Both verbs agree on that corpus: spec check on the same directory also exits 2 with the same stale-test-ref naming AUG-VER-STALE-1, so validate was not given a verb-specific bypass and the two parsers still agree. FAILIF: rc is 0, or the error class differs between the verbs (invalid-root here would be the AUG-134 split returning). PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec check tests/fixtures/xml/invalid/stale-test-obligation; echo rc=$?

The fix does not over-refuse: the shipped fixture corpus tests/fixtures/xml/specs still exits 0 printing "spec: 3 document(s), 10 block(s), 6 reference(s) ok" and the authored corpus specs/ still exits 0. FAILIF: either corpus is refused, or the printed counts change. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate tests/fixtures/xml/specs; echo fixtures_rc=$?; .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate specs; echo specs_rc=$?

The refusal follows the CITATION, not the committed fixture: a copy of a DIFFERENT shipped document (tests/fixtures/xml/verification/migration.xml) placed in a temp directory with only its path mutated to tests/does-not-exist.py is refused rc 2 with stale-test-ref naming TEST-MIG-1 and the resolved path, while the unmutated copy of the same file in a sibling temp directory is accepted rc 0. FAILIF: the mutant is accepted, or the control is refused. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && T=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir $T/ok $T/mut && cp tests/fixtures/xml/verification/migration.xml $T/ok/ && sed "s#path=\"tests/test_xml_specs.py\"#path=\"tests/does-not-exist.py\"#" tests/fixtures/xml/verification/migration.xml > $T/mut/m.xml && .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate --repo-root $PWD $T/mut; echo mutant_rc=$?; .venv/bin/python auger.py spec validate --repo-root $PWD $T/ok; echo control_rc=$?

The regression suites shipped with the fix pass on this tree: tests/test_spec_validate_obligations.py and tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py collect and pass 31 tests. FAILIF: any failure, error, or a collected count other than 31. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 DUCKBRAIN_API_KEY=$(cat ~/.duckbrain/foreman-status.token) python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_spec_validate_obligations.py tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py

The fix cannot silently fall out of the gate: tests/gate.sh names both regression files in its pytest arm (at least one occurrence each; 2 each measured today) and the fix commit 55a6725 is an ancestor of the judged HEAD. FAILIF: either file is absent from the arm, or the ancestry check exits non-zero. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && grep -c "tests/test_spec_validate_obligations.py" tests/gate.sh; grep -c "tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py" tests/gate.sh; git merge-base --is-ancestor 55a6725 HEAD; echo ancestor_rc=$?
